status_note: Retained as negative evidence only. Its destructive apply/merge/triangulate repair was superseded by live modifiers, typed bounded cleanup, and explicit topology rebuilding; it is excluded from runtime retrieval.
title: N-gons and degenerate faces after a boolean DIFFERENCE groove cut on a hard-surface body
problem: Cutting a decorative groove into a solid revolved body (e.g. a bottle) using a torus cutter whose major_radius equals the body's surface radius, via a boolean DIFFERENCE modifier + modifier_apply, produces a messy intersection seam: the exact boolean solver leaves many stray n-gons and zero-area (degenerate) faces where the cutter surface was tangent/near-coincident with the target surface, even though it does not necessarily leave non-manifold edges.
symptom: state_probe.mesh_health() on the target object shows a large jump in ngons (2 -> 54 in the observed case) and a nonzero degenerate_faces count (0 -> 10) immediately after bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply() on the boolean modifier, while non_manifold_edges can remain 0 -- so a check that only looks at non_manifold_edges would miss this defect entirely.

fix.summary: Merge coincident/near-coincident verts at a small threshold, recalc face normals, then triangulate any remaining n-gons. This single pass reliably clears both the n-gon spike and the degenerate faces because remove_doubles collapses the zero-area slivers the boolean solver leaves behind.
bpy_bmesh_steps: bmesh.ops.triangulate(bm, faces=[f for f in bm.faces if len(f.verts) > 4])
fix.code_snippet: Historical only; the unbounded blender_ops/repair.py helper was removed during Repo V2 consolidation.

evidence.verify_report_note: Independent tools/verify_mesh.py pass against the saved .blend happens in Milestone 5; this evidence is from the live-session state_probe check at the time of repair.

applicability: Any time a boolean modifier (especially DIFFERENCE with a cutter surface tangent or near-coincident with the target's own surface, e.g. a groove/ring cutter matching the body radius) is applied and converted to mesh on a hard-surface object, immediately probe mesh_health() for ngons and degenerate_faces (not just non_manifold_edges) and apply this same merge -> recalc -> triangulate sequence if either is nonzero.

generalization_evidence.context: Flashlight grip-ridge groove, boolean DIFFERENCE, torus cutter major_radius==body radius (same defect class as originally learned)
generalization_evidence.outcome: worked identically, as expected -- same operation type

generalization_evidence.context: Mug handle attachment, boolean UNION (not DIFFERENCE) of a torus onto a cylinder body -- genuinely different operation type than what the skill was learned from
generalization_evidence.outcome: generalized successfully -- the fix is not specific to DIFFERENCE, it addresses the boolean solver's tangent-geometry artifacts regardless of operation type. Applicability broadened based on this real evidence, not assumed in advance.
